role: District Representative · Lapu-Lapu City, Lone District
summary: Lapu-Lapu City representative with 96 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant bills are estate tax amnesty extensions, travel-tax abolition (one tax-relief issue) and an anti-dynasty ban. No dimension reaches two scorable issues.
caveat: Tax-relief bills treated as one issue; anti-dynasty is one democratic issue.
